https://www.instagram.com/This is the WORST electric car that we could find to take on a 500 mile road trip around Italy. It's not meant to leave the main city of Rome because NO ONE would do this due to its INSANE inconveniences. It's top speed is 25 miles an hour so you can only go on back roads and EVERYONE will pass you. It has no AC and only two tiny push windows so it is HOT at all times. If it rains, you have to pull over because all the windows will fog up and there is nothing you can do about it. And incase it couldn't get any worse, it only lasts up to 40 miles on a charge..but if you hit and mountains or elevation..you can expect to get A LOT less.
